summary: 30-foot pole tower built 1933 in the St. Joe National Forest; destroyed 1953; no source describes what remains at the site today.

facts.design: 30-foot pole tower, called L-4 in the sources
facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1953 according to both lookout pages.

events.note: 30-foot pole L-4 tower. Both lookout pages give 1933.
Both lookout pages give 1953. No cause is given.

evidence.supports: built 1933 as a 30-foot pole L-4 tower; destroyed 1953
evidence.quote: This 30' pole L-4 tower, built in 1933, was destroyed in 1953

evidence.supports: listed elevation 5,490 feet; St. Joe National Forest
patrol point 1.5 miles SSE atop Marcus Cook Point
evidence.quote: Patrol Point: 1.5 Miles SSE atop Marcus Cook Point

evidence.supports: about nine miles north of Avery
listed in Shoshone County; tower gone
site labelled Drive-Up; access not described

notes_for_editor: Both lookout pages carry the same Fire Lookout Museum photo credit, so they are probably not independent. The brief's record was right on status and kind but had no 1933 build event; added. Idaho Fire Lookouts says no staffing history is documented, so staffing is left out of the story. Two searches found no description of the site today, and the story says so. Access level is not stated by any source, so access is omitted.
